consequence: The actual residual and Schur source have all finite weighted Sobolev orders. Actual positive solves and every finite graph transfer are admissible in the original D_cert, so beta=E^-3 M(q3) is justified on the actual residual. Quantification reduces to R0 R2 R4 N6(p), but those high norms/constants have not been evaluated and no cold cancellation target passes.

primary_sources.title: Gerd Grubb, Spectral Asymptotics for Nonsmooth Singular Green Operators (2014)
primary_sources.location: Theorem 2.3, printed page 537, PDF index 8; surrounding symbol definitions inspected
primary_sources.established_result: Finite Holder symbol seminorms and sufficiently many frequency derivatives control the normalized operator in L2. Apply this at order zero to each differentiated normalized symbol; the higher-order extension is proved separately by commutators.
primary_sources.does_not_supply: The actual charged coefficients, conormal endpoint extension, mass column, nonlinear quantum source identification or useful numerical constants.

primary_sources.title: Anders Gaarde and Gerd Grubb, Logarithms and sectorial projections for elliptic boundary problems
primary_sources.location: Theorem 2.4 equations (2.20)-(2.24), Proposition 2.9; PDF indices 7 and 12
primary_sources.established_result: Smooth differential boundary models have reflected resolvent symbol estimates; their logarithms include a specific singular boundary term, so an ordinary smoothing assertion is insufficient.
primary_sources.does_not_supply: An all-order theorem for the actual logarithmic compactification. Higher derivatives here come from scaled interior estimates applied to the retained boundary remainder, not an unqualified use of a smooth boundary theorem.

comparison: The predecessor proves every finite conormal metric order but not finite-metric source regularity. The earlier weighted inverse controls only two derivatives. This result supplies source regularity, higher critical TT regularity, the positive inverse bootstrap and compact-core convergence. It supplies admissibility rather than the unevaluated numerical cancellation inequality. The coupled periodic fixture has a nonzero resonant moment preserved through all three transfers, detecting a false inference of suppression from admissibility.
verification_scope: Exact actual-path/density identities, weighted-kernel commutators with contact omission control, tail integrals, finite derivative accounting and a coupled noncommuting finite-Fourier continuum model. It does not compute the charged source, kernel, high norms or actual signed moment; continuum estimates remain ordinary proofs.
